function.name: describe_chart
function.description: Attach a one-sentence caption to a chart created this run. The caption is shown beneath the chart and becomes the pre-filled, editable takeaway when the user adds the chart to their findings report. Your mode instructions define exactly what the caption may contain — follow them precisely. Call it after reading the chart's visualize observation; calling it again for the same chart replaces the earlier caption.

chart_id.description: The chart id from the visualize observation's '**Chart id**' line (e.g. 'chart-...').

description.description: The caption: one sentence, ≤25 words, grounded in the observed result data. Content rules come from your mode instructions.
